first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding currently has the best fit with two simultaneous declines: onboarding completion and activation. Prior evidence indicates durable activation and early-adoption gains, while promotional pricing directly addresses competitive pressure but requires verification of revenue quality and retention effects before prioritization. Verify the strongest onboarding evidence and the main pricing alternative.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. Verified evidence shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainability. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failure through first renewal. Measure activation, retained qualified revenue, and cohort retention rather than treating onboarding completion alone as success.
